Apple Arcade’s May lineup introduces four new titles today on the subscription gaming platform. Apple Arcade games have no ads and no in-app purchases.

Four new Apple Arcade games arrive today

Apple Arcade subscribers gain access to three new titles today.

The first is Good Pizza, Great Pizza+, an Apple Arcade version of the cooking business simulator without all the in-app purchase mechanics from the App Store version.

Physics puzzler Perchang World and Ultimate 8 Ball Pool+, an Arcade version of the App Store title, also arrive today.

The other big release launching today is Nick Jr. Replay!, which includes mini-games with familiar characters from these shows: Dora the Explorer, Blue’s Clues & You!, Blaze and the Monster Machines, Bubble Guppies, Team Umizoomi, Shimmer and Shine, and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

“Families can take a trip down memory lane, revisiting more than 50 retro Nick Jr. games, all authentically preserved in a vibrant, interactive universe,” Apple says. “This safe and engaging playground helps young players build essential skills in math, reading, art, and problem-solving.”

Apple also recently highlighted updates to Hello Kitty Island Adventure that arrived on April 16 and new Star Wars content in Disney SpellStruck released on April 23.

Apple Arcade is available, ad-free and with no in-app purchases, for $6.99/month after a one-month free trial. A single subscription unlocks access for up to five users through Family Sharing.

Apple Arcade is also included in every Apple One bundle subscription.
